france_population_registries.coverage: 16.4% of French births in 2019-2021; the report projects about 23.6% once the Nouvelle-Aquitaine registry is fully deployed (an objective, not a measured figure)
france_population_registries.eurocat: EUROCAT network: 43 population-based registries in 21 European countries, about 1.5 million births a year (report, box 1)
